//: Merge these hooks into your .claude/settings.json. Do NOT replace the file — you almost certainly have hooks of your own.
//PostToolUse: Routes every edit to its owning area and appends it to the armed mission's queue. Inert outside a mission: no flag, or a missionStatus that is not 'active', and it no-ops. It never blocks and never fails a tool call.
//SessionStart: Injects the mission rehydration brief (<=6KB) whenever a mission is armed and active. This is the whole point of the brief: a fresh window inherits position AND knowledge for ~1.5k tokens instead of re-deriving it from source, which costs orders of magnitude more. Silent when no mission is running.
